import sys
import json

FLAG_ORDER = ("invalid", "overflow", "underflow", "inexact")


def solve(req):
    ebits = req["ebits"]
    fbits = req["fbits"]
    mode = req["mode"]
    pairs = req.get("pairs") or []

    bias = (1 << (ebits - 1)) - 1
    F = 1 << fbits
    Eall = (1 << ebits) - 1
    emin = 1 - bias
    emax = Eall - 1 - bias
    fmask = F - 1
    spos = ebits + fbits          # position of the sign bit
    top_frac = 1 << (fbits - 1)   # quiet/signaling distinguishing bit

    any_nan = False
    invalid = False
    pos_inf = False
    neg_inf = False
    terms = []                    # nonzero finite products: (sign, mantissa, scale2)
    all_neg_zero = len(pairs) > 0  # "all products are negative signed zeros"

    for pair in pairs:
        a, b = pair
        va = int(a or "0", 16)
        vb = int(b or "0", 16)
        sa = (va >> spos) & 1
        ea = (va >> fbits) & Eall
        fa = va & fmask
        sb = (vb >> spos) & 1
        eb = (vb >> fbits) & Eall
        fb = vb & fmask

        a_nan = ea == Eall and fa != 0
        b_nan = eb == Eall and fb != 0
        if a_nan:
            any_nan = True
            if not (fa & top_frac):
                invalid = True    # signaling NaN operand
        if b_nan:
            any_nan = True
            if not (fb & top_frac):
                invalid = True
        if a_nan or b_nan:
            # contributes no infinite product, cannot be zero*infinity
            continue

        ps = sa ^ sb
        a_inf = ea == Eall        # fa == 0 here
        b_inf = eb == Eall
